name: Eastern Mau Forest Reserve
description: Eastern Mau Forest Reserve, Rift Valley, Kenya (EPSG:4326). A critical tropical montane ecosystem, water tower, and biodiversity corridor experiencing land use pressure and forest canopy changes.

name: Harz National Park (Dieback Zone)
description: Harz National Park, Lower Saxony / Saxony-Anhalt, Germany (EPSG:4326). European montane spruce forest monitoring area subjected to drought stress, severe storms, and bark beetle (Ips typographus) dieback.
